summary: Phase 3 abgeschlossen. Alle ROADMAP [x]-Einträge haben korrespondierende Quelldateien. Vier Produktiv-Stubs erfordern weitere Integration bevor Beta-Status erreichbar ist.

findings.expected: labelAll() and labelQuery() read documents via the AQL query executor
findings.observed: auto_labeler.cpp: database fetch is a TODO stub; labelDocument() is fully implemented
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(training): wire LegalAutoLabeler DB fetch to AQL query executor

findings.expected: findSimilarDocuments() performs cosine similarity search over document embeddings
findings.observed: knowledge_graph_enricher.cpp: vector index query is a commented AQL template; returns empty list until query executor is wired
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(training): wire findSimilarDocuments to vector index / embedding store

findings.expected: IncrementalLoRATrainer manipulates real LoRA model weights and serializes checkpoint data
findings.observed: Model weight manipulation, optimizer state, and checkpoint serialization are simulated with placeholder values; ML framework integration (e.g. llama.cpp LoRA APIs) is absent
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(training): integrate real LoRA weight manipulation via llama.cpp / libtorch

findings.expected: deployVersion(version, traffic_split) routes a configurable fraction of LLM traffic to the new adapter
findings.observed: Traffic splitting is a configuration placeholder; production deployment requires a routing layer update in the LLM integration module
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(training/llm): wire deployVersion traffic-split to LLM routing layer
